Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai

Class RangedAI

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.EntityAI
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.RangedAI
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.bukkit.event.Listener
public class RangedAI extends EntityAI
Ranged AI implementation.

Entities with this AI detect players within aggroRange, check for line-of-sight, and fire arrow projectiles at the target when the shot cooldown expires. The entity also rotates to face its target but does not walk — it is a stationary ranged attacker by default. Subclass and override onTick() if you want it to also move.

Arrow damage is driven by DumbEntity.getDamage() and launch speed can be tuned via setProjectileSpeed(double).
